anchor.note: Multiplication in integer arithmetic, covered by the reader's degree (modular arithmetic and introductory discrete mathematics).

gaps.quote: The source permutation cancels across the two forward source transforms, their pointwise product, and the transform with the opposite sign
gaps.note: The page never says what the source permutation is, what the two forward source transforms are, or which transforms are meant by the transform with the opposite sign. The reader cannot check that the permutation cancels.

gaps.quote: Removing the known normalizations and digit scales then leaves the convolution of the digits as integer coefficients.
gaps.note: The page does not state what the normalizations or digit scales are, nor why removing them leaves exactly the digit convolution with integer coefficients.

gaps.quote: Its error is controlled by the single truncation after each
gaps.note: The page asserts the error is controlled by one truncation per layer and must be bounded after all layers, but never says what the truncation error is or computes the bound.

gaps.quote: since carries undo the evaluation at a power of two
gaps.note: The page does not show how the packing is an evaluation at a power of two or why carry propagation exactly undoes it.

gaps.quote: each recovered coefficient has error below one half (cited)
gaps.note: This cited bound is the justification for rounding, but the page does not say what the error is or how the truncation bound yields one half for each coefficient. The cited claim stands in for how the recovery itself works, and the page does not give its content beyond the bare statement.
